app.err.no_url: The tix server URL is not configured; an admin sets it in System Console > Plugins > tix
app.err.not_linked: Your Mattermost account is not connected to tix yet: run `/tix connect`
app.err.tix_401: tix rejected your token (expired or revoked?). Reconnect with `/tix connect`.
app.err.tix_403: tix says you are not allowed to do that: {message}
cards.cmd.sync: Mirror replies in this channel's task card threads to tix comments, and back (channel admins)
cards.cmd.sync_on: Mirror card threads and tix comments
command.admins_only: Only system admins can run that.
digest.all_clear: All clear: nothing overdue, due today, new, blocked or in progress.
digest.cmd.digest: Get a daily DM summary of your tix tasks
digest.cmd.digest_on: Send it every workday at this time (default 09:00, your time zone)
digest.cmd.digest_quiet: Skip a digest with nothing to report
digest.cmd.reminders: Get a DM when a task assigned to you is due today or overdue
digest.cmd.reminders_on: Remind me of due and overdue tasks
digest.section.title: {title} ({count})
link.cmd.connect: Connect your Mattermost account to tix
link.cmd.disconnect: Disconnect from tix and revoke the token the plugin holds
link.cmd.me: Show the tix account you are connected as
notify.cmd.notifications: Turn your personal tix DMs on or off
notify.cmd.subscribe: Post a project's tix activity in this channel
notify.cmd.subscriptions: List the tix feeds of this channel
notify.cmd.unsubscribe: Stop posting a project's tix activity in this channel
notify.cmd.webhook: Register, check or remove the webhook tix sends events to
notify.cmd.webhook_remove: Remove the plugin's webhook from tix
notify.cmd.webhook_setup: Register or update the plugin's webhook in tix
notify.cmd.webhook_status: Show the webhook and its recent deliveries
notify.subscribe.bad_value: `{option} {value}` is not valid; use one of {allowed}
tasks.cmd.assign: Assign a task, or unassign it with none
tasks.cmd.assign_who: Who: @user, me, none or a tix handle
tasks.cmd.channel: Show this channel's tix settings; channel admins set its default project for /tix new and the create reaction
tasks.cmd.channel_project: Set or clear this channel's default project (channel admins)
tasks.cmd.close: Close a task without doing it (cancelled state, else done)
tasks.cmd.done: Move a task to its done state
tasks.cmd.due: Your open tasks due today or overdue, soonest first
tasks.cmd.list: List open tasks: yours by default, a project's, or a tix filter such as status:todo tag:ops
tasks.cmd.list_filter: tix filter terms: status:todo tag:ops priority:high @user due:week title~api
tasks.cmd.mine: Your open tasks (same as /tix list mine)
tasks.cmd.mine_filter: tix filter terms: status:todo tag:ops priority:high
tasks.cmd.move: Move a task to a state of its workflow
tasks.cmd.new: Create a task, in the channel's default project unless you name one; the title takes tix quick-add tokens: !high #tag @user due:fri
tasks.cmd.new_project: Project (optional; the channel's default is listed first)
tasks.cmd.reopen: Move a finished task back to an open state
tasks.cmd.search: Full-text search over titles and bodies, finished tasks included unless you add open
tasks.cmd.search_text: Text, then optionally a project, filter terms (status:todo tag:ops @user) and open
tasks.cmd.show: Show a task with its latest comments
tasks.cmd.start: Move a task to its in-progress state
